column1: # Organization map of the identity test overlay (infra/compose/identity.yml; G014, G016; test only). One platform
# host[:port], a tab, then the Organization UUID infra/identity/mcp-seed.sql creates with that host's slug. Since G016
# core reads no host registry (MCP_TENANT_HOSTS_FILE is retired and refused): tenant hosts resolve through Organization
# slugs and verified domains; the harness reads this map only to pass the seed and the MCP driver the UUIDs.
